item.description: It still asks, for pull requests only, that the pull request's review deck explain every changed line; its comment no longer says the health gate is waiting.
item.label: The review job is unchanged

item.description: Builds change-saga from the commit under test (a pull request's own head, with full history) and runs check --covers health change.saga, which exits 3 when anything the Saga documents went stale or broke.
item.label: A health job gates the Saga

item.description: change.saga ships as the example Saga, so this repository requires its health on every pull request and push; teams choose their own rules, and the product requires none.
item.label: A policy for this repository's showcase Saga

slide.takeaway: Beside the review gate, a health job fails CI when anything change.saga already documents goes stale or breaks.
slide.title: CI now keeps change.saga healthy
